# pai queue

Queue small changes, run them on a local worker, review in a batch

```
pai queue <command>
```

A local queue for one-sentence changes: add them, drain them in worktree branches, review the ready ones together, accept (merge with the gate) or send back with a note. See docs/queue.md.

```sh
pai queue add "tooltip says Sav"
pai queue run
pai queue review
pai queue accept q1
```

### pai queue add

Queue one small change, described in a sentence

```
pai queue add TEXT [options]
```

Stores the sentence (plus optional files and an image) as a pending item of the project. The worker spec is composed at run time: your sentence, the files, the project's queue rules and a fixed footer (relative paths, git add then commit, keep it small, report with R).

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TEXT` | yes | One sentence: the symptom or the element |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--files A,B` | string | — | Files the change probably touches (items sharing a file never run together) |
| `--image PATH` | string | — | Screenshot or mock-up the worker should look at |
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Project slug or folder (default: the git checkout of the current directory) |

```sh
pai queue add "the save button tooltip says Sav"
pai queue add "move the export button next to Share" --files src/Toolbar.tsx
```

See also: `pai queue run`, `pai queue review`

### pai queue run

Drain the pending items on the local provider; nothing is merged

```
pai queue run [options]
```

Runs each pending item as a worker in its own worktree branch, up to N at once. A finished item becomes ready (diff stat, gate result in the worktree, proof output, worker report), too-big when it exceeds max_files/max_lines, or after one local retry with the failure tail needs-decision. Merging is `pai queue accept`. The gate runs only if .pai/queue.yaml names one; no test suite otherwise. With --escalate sonnet, only items marked cloud (two failed `again` rounds) run, on one Sonnet worker each.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Project slug or folder (default: the git checkout of the current directory) |
| `--local` | flag | — | Run on the local model server PAI resolves (the one that answers); never pick a local provider by name |
| `--provider NAME` | string | — | Provider name (the detached runner passes what it resolved; the value local is resolved at run start) |
| `--parallel N` | number | — | Items running at once (default: max_parallel of queue.yaml, else the provider's maxConcurrent) |
| `--escalate TIER` | string | — | Run the cloud items on TIER (only workers.escalate.cloud.tier) |
| `--model MODEL` | string | — | Model the items' workers get: default, fast or a model id (default: the provider's worker_model) |
| `--now` | flag | — | The items' workers go ahead of the runs waiting for a slot on the provider |
| `--no-pool` | flag | — | The items' workers start fresh, never using the worker pool |
| `--detach` | flag | — | Hand the run to a detached process that outlives this session and reports ready / needs-decision items back to it |

```sh
pai queue run
pai queue run --detach
pai queue run --parallel 2
pai queue run --escalate sonnet
```

See also: `pai queue review`, `pai queue accept`, `pai plan run`

### pai queue review

One compact list of ready items: sentence, diff stat, gate, proof

```
pai queue review [options]
```

Lists the ready items of the project. Judge them, then `pai queue accept`, `reject` or `again`.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Project slug or folder (default: the git checkout of the current directory) |

```sh
pai queue review
```

See also: `pai queue accept`, `pai queue reject`, `pai queue again`

### pai queue list

Every item of the project with its state

```
pai queue list [options]
```

States: pending, running, ready, too-big, needs-decision, cloud, accepted, rejected.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Project slug or folder (default: the git checkout of the current directory) |

```sh
pai queue list
```

See also: `pai queue review`

### pai queue accept

Merge ready items with the project's gate, then run its install command

```
pai queue accept ID... [options]
```

For each id: `pai worker merge --verify GATE` (a failing gate reverts the merge and the item stays ready), then the install command of .pai/queue.yaml.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID...` | yes | Queue item id(s), e.g. q3 |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Project slug or folder (default: the git checkout of the current directory) |

```sh
pai queue accept q3 q4
```

See also: `pai queue review`

### pai queue reject

Drop items; their branches stay for `pai worker gc`

```
pai queue reject ID... [options]
```

Marks the items rejected.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID...` | yes | Queue item id(s), e.g. q3 |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Project slug or folder (default: the git checkout of the current directory) |
| `--why TEXT` | string | — | Reason, kept on the item |

```sh
pai queue reject q2 --why "wrong button"
```

See also: `pai queue list`

### pai queue again

Re-queue an item with what is still wrong

```
pai queue again ID NOTE [options]
```

Re-queues the item with the previous attempt's diff and your note appended to the spec. After two such rounds the item is marked cloud and is taken by `pai queue run --escalate sonnet`.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Queue item id |
| `NOTE` | yes | What is still wrong |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Project slug or folder (default: the git checkout of the current directory) |

```sh
pai queue again q3 "still not: the tooltip is clipped on the left"
```

See also: `pai queue run`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai queue add` | Queue one small change, described in a sentence |
| `pai queue run` | Drain the pending items on the local provider; nothing is merged |
| `pai queue review` | One compact list of ready items: sentence, diff stat, gate, proof |
| `pai queue list` | Every item of the project with its state |
| `pai queue accept` | Merge ready items with the project's gate, then run its install command |
| `pai queue reject` | Drop items; their branches stay for `pai worker gc` |
| `pai queue again` | Re-queue an item with what is still wrong |
